Grade-3 Class-B: Mai Akagi/Morimi Asakaga/Hatsune Ayasaki/Kiyomi Iguchi/Masumi Ichijo/Yukie Ueda/Kyoko Uchida/Sayaka Enoki/Yuka Okano/Akane Ogura/Mari Oda/Miyuki Ochi/Megumu Kanzaki/Chizuko Kimura/Mami Saeki/Emi Sanokura/Mizuho Sawa/Kaho Shimizu/Yuki Sinohara/Yu Seno/Mitsuko Tanzawa/Masami Terada/Miyako Tohmi/Maho Nakane/Kazuki Nasuhara/Makie Natsuki/Tina Nishimura/Yukari Nyuishi/Sawako Hayashi/Moe Hibikino/Shizue Matsuki/Hiroko Mitarai/Mai Minaduki/Ayumi Yuki/Rieko Wakui/Kotomi Wakura

It is Christmas Eve, and the students of class 3-B are getting ready for a party when a terrorist group posing as environmental activists seizes their school and takes them hostage.

Noel 3 is a hacking adventure. Break into the school's systems from the outside to guide the trapped girls to safety, and use the visual phone to check on them and tell them where to hide. Yuka Okano, who slipped away from the captors, helps from her hiding place. Try to bring every student home safely - how many you save shapes the ending.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1 player
- Hacking-based rescue gameplay
- Visual phone conversations with the class 3-B girls
